columns_never_fillable.reason: Per-property NPI is not disclosed. The audited segment note (Note 24) reports NPI only at segment level (Commercial S$130,375k; Hospitality S$89,204k), and the portfolio review gives per-property revenue and revenue-contribution % but no per-property NPI.
Commercial assets disclose NLA (lettable), not GLA; hotels disclose GFA + room keys, not lettable area. No gross lettable area is disclosed per property.
Hilton Singapore Orchard and Crowne Plaza Changi Airport are master-leased and reported by RevPAR (S$260 and S$246 respectively), not committed occupancy %.
Hotel size is disclosed as room keys (Hilton 1,080; Crowne Plaza 575) and GFA, not net lettable area.

reconciliation.valuation_reconciliation_note: Sum of the 5 fully-consolidated property valuations = S$5,082.0m, ties to audited independent valuation (page 134). Carrying amount S$5,105,632k = 5,082,000 + lease liability 22,612 + lease prepayment 1,020. OUE Bayfront (S$1,422.0m at 100%) is a 50% equity-accounted JV, excluded from the consolidated investment-properties statement (Investment in joint venture S$334,941k).

inferred.basis: Computed as land-lease start date + lease term (e.g. 99-year lease from 1 Jul 1957 -> 2056-06-30; 66-year lease from 9 Jun 2017 -> 2083-06-08). Not disclosed as an explicit expiry date in the report.

ORP has multiple component leases (Tower 1 and ~75% of retail podium: 841-year lease from 1 Nov 1985; Tower 2 and balance: 99-year lease from 26 May 1983). Per the multi-lease rule the EARLIER expiry is used: Tower 2's 99-year lease from 26 May 1983 -> 2082-05-25. lease_term_years (841) reflects the dominant/longest component; full wording in tenure_raw.
Effective interest 67.95% disclosed (page 35 footnote 5); = 83.33% (OUE REIT in OUB Centre) x 81.54% (OUB Centre in ORP). Carried at 100% in the consolidated FS with 16.67% NCI at OUB Centre level.
Derived: ebit (116,582) + depreciation of plant & equipment 51 (from cash flow / segment note). Fair-value REIT with no material P&L D&A.

Disclosed Singapore office portfolio committed occupancy as at 31 Dec 2025 (page 36). No single portfolio-wide committed-occupancy figure is disclosed (hotels master-leased, reported by RevPAR). Flagged in performance.flags.
